About the Team
 
The Commerce Platform team at Meesho drives end-to-end growth, strategy, and operational excellence across key verticals:
- User Growth: Scales the full lifecycle funnel—from acquisition and activation to retention—ensuring sustainable user growth and engagement
across the platform.
- Marketplace: Focuses on strengthening the seller ecosystem and improving selection quality to create a robust and reliable marketplace experience.
- Category: Identifies high-potential segments, launches and scales new categories, and drives assortment expansion to meet evolving customer
demand.
- Mall: Builds a trusted branded destination for quality-conscious users, enhancing the platform’s premium and branded shopping experience.
- Pricing: Ensures competitiveness and affordability, enabling the platform to deliver strong value for customers while maintaining marketplace
health.
- Content Commerce: Powers content-led discovery through creator ecosystems and inspiration-driven shopping journeys that drive engagement,
trust, and conversion.
Together, these verticals identify whitespace opportunities, launch and scale new initiatives, and continuously optimize the user lifecycle through
data-backed decisions. Operating in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment, the team combines structured problem-solving with rapid execution to
deliver meaningful impact.
If you’re excited about building for Bharat, this role offers both strategic depth and hands-on impact.
About the Role 
 
As an Associate Director – Programs, you will be a senior leader responsible for one or more strategic charters that drive key business and customer
outcomes. You will own end-to-end problem-solving for critical workstreams, navigating complex challenges and ensuring strong execution and
operational excellence across the organization.
This is a hybrid individual contributor and people-manager role. You will directly lead high-priority initiatives while managing and developing a team
of Senior Managers and Managers. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to translate ambiguous strategic priorities into structured,
executable programs.
This is a hands-on leadership role requiring strong analytical depth. You will work closely with data, conduct root-cause analyses, understand
underlying customer and business dynamics, and use these insights to set direction and deliver measurable outcomes.


What You Will Do
Strategy & Problem Solving: Identify 10x impact opportunities across your charter and build conviction through opportunity sizing and early

experiments to scale a charter into a company-level bet.

- End-to-End Ownership: Own the ideation, implementation, and delivery of key business metrics (P&L, GMV , NMV , or KRs) across the

workstreams in your charter.

- Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with and influence senior cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Tech, Design, Analytics,

Marketing, Finance, and Operations to align on and deliver business objectives.

- Program Management: Build and defend a prioritization framework across immediate, medium, and long-term goals; craft KPIs and reporting/monitoring cadences that drive efficiency and operational excellence across large-scale programs.

-  Data-Driven Execution & RCA: Own rigorous root-cause analyses when business-critical metrics move — distinguishing genuine signal from noise, selection effects, or measurement artifacts — and present data-backed solutions to senior leadership.

-  People Leadership: Manage, coach, and grow a team of Senior Managers and Managers on select workstreams while directly driving other high-priority initiatives as an individual contributor.

-  Vision & Roadmap: Understand the market landscape and customer/seller behavior to define the medium- to long-term (12–18 month+) roadmap for your charter areas.

-  Represent the Business View: Represent the business perspective in cross-functional forums — pushing back on framings that don't hold up, and ensuring decisions are grounded in actual user/seller/business realities.

-  Talent & Team Building: Hire, coach, and develop Senior Managers and Managers on your team; act as a talent magnet for the org, and build a psychologically safe, autonomous culture where the team can take bold bets and fail fast.

-  Speed & Org-Level Unblocking: Set the org's cadence for fast, high-quality decision-making — aligning cross-functional stakeholders and dependencies (people, process, tools) so teams can move from V1 to V2/V3 quickly, without compromising quality.

-  Long-Term Vision & BHAGs: Define the 2–3 year roadmap and help shape Meesho's BHAGs for your charter areas, continuously evaluating direction and course-correcting to stay aligned to long-term goals.

What You will Need
-  Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree from a top-tier institute.

-  Experience: 7–10+ years of relevant experience in Growth, Strategy & Ops, Management Consulting, or a high-growth startup/e-commerce environment.

-  Analytical Aptitude: Strong "problem-first" thinking with the ability to break down complex, ambiguous problem statements into structured, actionable plans.

-  Executional Experience and P&L/KPI Ownership: Demonstrated executional experience in driving initiatives end-to-end, along with ownership of business KPIs and/or P&L metrics, with accountability for measurable outcomes at scale.

-  Communication: Excellent negotiation and communication skills to align multiple senior stakeholders on a long-term vision and generate buy-in.

-  People Leadership: Proven ability to hire, manage, mentor, and develop teams (including Senior Managers/Managers), alongside a strong track record of hands-on individual execution.

-  Adaptability: Ability to identify areas of improvement across business categories and Meesho as a whole, and to operate with high fungibility across sub-organizations.

-  Growth Mindset: Demonstrated track record of building a culture of continuous learning and feedback — for yourself and your team.
